cards.title: Why is the grass green and which was the deadliest dinosaur? The kids' quiz
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions set by children test your knowledge on fun topics. Submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: I'm giving birth as a battle rages over maternity care in Ireland
cards.body: An unfair two-tier system in Irish maternity care is giving way to universal state care. Private interests and highly paid doctors are resisting this change.

cards.title: The hill I will die on: A music festival isn't a music festival without children
cards.body: Bringing toddlers to music festivals adds magic and family joy to the experience. Families enhance events rather than spoil them.

cards.title: Parenting Considerations for Raising Gifted Children
cards.body: Advanced learners face unique problems in their approach to schooling. Understanding these challenges helps parents support gifted children effectively.

cards.title: Transitional Objects and Memory
cards.body: Winnicott's transitional objects theory shows how items like cards become containers for memory, identity, and connection across generations. This framework helps parents understand children's attachment to special objects.
